scope: Read-only difference and format audit plus independent execution of the seven supplied Python packaging tests. No Cargo, compiler, generated program or full archive rerun.
verdict: Pass within this tool-change scope; no newly introduced overwrite, byte-rewrite or restore-path regression found.

comparison.other_changes: README describes the newly recognized binary evidence; test suite adds one binary I/O/CT/cache case and changes its temporary-directory label.

producer_checks.finding: encode_ct / encode_ct_program / Writer::header: exact ZILCTIR\0 and ZILCTPG\0 headers, followed by Wire version; raw candidates carry no executable authority.
ArtifactCache::path and write_with_hook: <key>.candidate, followed by exact ZILRAW02/key/digest/length/payload bytes.
execute: fs::write raw input to .stdin, expected output to .expected.stdout, actual stdout/stderr bytes to .stdout/.stderr.
execute: raw input/output recorded under {label}.stdin/.stdout/.stderr; no UTF-8 conversion in recorded payloads.

classification_findings: CTPG and CTIR match the exact actual producer prefixes; malformed payload bytes after a retained prefix are evidence, not a claim of valid IR.
Cache evidence requires both .candidate suffix and ZILRAW02 prefix. This does not admit arbitrary .bin data.
Standard-I/O suffixes come from actual test producers and deliberately precede machine magic: ELF-looking stdin is a recorded input, not an executable product.
Ordinary executables, object/library products and machine magic retain the old hash-only directory behavior; execution products inside sealed source archives still cause explicit rejection.
Unknown nontext inputs still fail packaging with a retained partial; no new catch-and-ignore or lossy text decode was added.
integrity_findings: include hashes and stores the original data bytes; UTF-8 decode is only an old classification check and does not re-encode content.
Original source archive identity and original path mapping remain in INDEX; SHA-addressed objects deduplicate content without merging original results or paths.
pack uses an exclusive .partial, verifies it and the cap, then hardlinks without replacing any existing final output. Existing outputs/partials are rejected.
verify checks duplicate members, safe path syntax, manifest/member identity, CRC/SHA/length, exact object references and restored mappings.

restore verifies before creating a new destination, uses safe mapped relative paths and exclusive file creation; existing destination is rejected. Tests show corrupt objects and traversal inputs cannot publish/restore an accepted archive.
limits: This is archive integrity and classification review, not validation of CT/cache candidate semantics or language acceptance.
Only configured, frozen evidence sources are covered; unsupported binary names remain explicit failures rather than being automatically included.
Original ZIP bytes are not recreated by logical restoration; original container identities are retained, as documented.
